parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) A microphone in a recording studio has a mass of 0.55 kg and a weight W .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The microphone is suspended from the ceiling by a cord attached to a small ring. Fig. 1.1 shows the microphone pulled to one side and kept stationary by a horizontal thread. Fig. 1.1 (not to scale) The tension T in the horizontal thread is 8.1 N. Determine graphically the magnitude and the direction, relative to the vertical, of the resultant of W and T . Use a scale of 1.0 cm to 1.0 N or greater. magnitude of resultant = ................................................................ direction of resultant = ................................... relative to vertical [3]

ms.label: 1(c)(ii)
ms.text:
correct right-angled triangle / rectangle / intersecting arcs seen e.g.
(magnitude from) 9.6 to 10.0 N
(angle to vertical from) 54.0 to 57.5°

ms.label: 1(c)(iii)
ms.text:
any two of:
equal (in magnitude)
opposite (in direction)
the ring is in equilibrium or no resultant force on ring
or forces on ring balance
